description: A data model for code generation

SupplyTechnology.docstring: Candidate generation technology for a region. Can represent either a thermal or renewable generation technology

power_systems_type.description: Corresponding type in PowerSystems.jl to be used in PCM modeling

region.description: Location where technology operates. Can be a zone or node.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`)

cofire_start_limits.description: Minimum and maximum blending level (%) of each fuel during start-up process for multi-fuel generator

cofire_level_limits.description: Minimum and maximum blending level (%) of each fuel during normal generation process for multi-fuel generator

capital_costs.description: Capital costs for investing in a technology. (USD/MW)

operation_costs.description: Fixed and variable O&M costs for a technology

unit_size.description: Used for discrete investment decisions. Size of each unit being built (MW)

capacity_limits.description: Minimum and maximum allowable installed capacity for a technology (MW)

outage_factors.description: Derating factor to account for planned or forced outages of a technology. Fraction of hours in a year where technology is unavailable.

min_generation_fraction.description: Minimum generation as a fraction of total capacity (MW)

ramp_limits.description: Maximum decrease and increase in output between operation periods. Fraction of nameplate capacity per hour

time_limits.description: Minimum amount of time a resource has to stay in the committed or shutdown state (hours).

start_fuel_mmbtu_per_mw.description: Startup fuel use per MW of nameplate capacity of each generator (MMBtu/MW per start)

lifetime.description: Maximum number of years a technology can be active once installed (years)

financial_data.description: Struct containing relevant financial information for a technology

requirements.description: List of requirements (i.e. reserve margin, capacity requirements, energy share requirements) that are associated with a technology

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

RetirementPotential.docstring: Supplemental attribute used to define what existing generators are eligible for retirement for a SupplyTechnology

eligible_generators.description: Names of individual generation units mapped to a technology that are eligible for retirement

planned_retirement_year.description: Optional dictionary to indicate the year in which the forced/planned retirement will occur

build_year.description: Optional dictionary to indicate the year in which existing generators in the base system were built

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

AggregateRetirementPotential.docstring: Supplemental attribute used to define a total amount of existing capacity that can be retired for a technology

retirement_potential.description: Amount of pre-existing capacity for a technology that is eligible for retirement

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

RetrofitPotential.docstring: Supplemental attribute used to define what existing generators are eligible for retrofit for a SupplyTechnology

eligible_generators.description: Names of individual generation units mapped to this technology that can be retrofitted

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

AggregateRetrofitPotential.docstring: Supplemental attribute used to define a total amount of capacity that can be retrofit for a SupplyTechnology

retrofit_id.description: Unique identifier to group retrofittable source technologies with retrofit options inside the same zone.

retrofit_potential.description: Amount of existing capacity for technology that can be retrofitted

retrofit_fraction.description: Fraction of existing capacity that is eligible for retrofits. Alternative to retrofit_potential

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

ExistingDevices.docstring: Supplemental attributed used to map technologies in a portfolio to the existing system. For example, contains a list of existing generators that correspond to a SupplyTechnology.

existing_devices.description: List of individual existing devices to map to a specific technology in the portfolio

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

TopologyMapping.docstring: Supplemental attributed used to store mapping between the PSIP Zone and the associated buses in the base system.

buses.description: List of buses in the base system that are associated with a zone

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

StorageTechnology.docstring: Candidate storage technology in a region.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`)

power_systems_type.description: Corresponding type in PowerSystems.jl to be used in PCM modeling

capital_costs_storage.description: Capital costs for investing in a storage technology. (USD/MWh)

operation_costs.description: Fixed and variable O&M costs for a technology

min_discharge_fraction.description: Minimum discharge as a fraction of total discharge capacity

unit_size_charge.description: Used for discrete investment decisions. Unit size of charging capacity (MW)

unit_size_discharge.description: Used for discrete investment decisions. Size of each unit of discharging capacity being built (MW)

unit_size_energy.description: Used for discrete investment decisions. Size of each unit being built (MWh)

capacity_limits_charge.description: allowable installed power capacity for a storage technology (MW)

capacity_limits_discharge.description: allowable installed power capacity for a storage technology (MW)

capacity_limits_energy.description: allowable installed energy capacity for a storage technology (MWh)

duration_limits.description: Minimum and maximum duration limits (energy to discharge capacity ratio) for a storage technology (hours)

efficiency.description: Efficiency of charging storage, fraction of total charge (in) and discharge (out) capacity

losses.description: Self-discharge of storage (fraction of energy stored per hour)

lifetime.description: Maximum number of years a technology can be active once installed (years)

financial_data.description: Struct containing relevant financial information for a technology

requirements.description: List of requirements (i.e. reserve margin, capacity requirements, energy share requirements) that are associated with a technology

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

DemandSideTechnology.docstring: Represents demand side technologies such as electric vehicles or hydrogen electrolyzers.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`)

power_systems_type.description: Corresponding type in PowerSystems.jl to be used in PCM modeling

technology_efficiency.description: MWh of electricity per unit of output. Ex: MWh per ton of hydrogen for electrolyzers

price_per_unit.description: Price or value per unit of output. Ex: USD per ton of hydrogen for electrolyzers

min_power.description: Minimum operation of demandside unit as a fraction of peak demand

curtailment_cost.description: Energy cost of curtailed demand, USD per Mwh

max_demand_curtailment.description: Maximum fraction of demand that can be curtailed

max_demand_delay.description: Maximum number of hours that demand can be deferred or delayed (hours).

max_demand_advance.description: Maximum number of hours that demand can be scheduled in advance of the original schedule (hours).

demand_energy_efficiency.description: Energy efficiency associated with time shifting demand. Represents energy losses due to time shifting

shift_variable_cost.description: Variable operation and maintenance costs associated with flexible demand deferral/advancement

requirements.description: List of requirements (i.e. reserve margin, capacity requirements, energy share requirements) that are associated with a technology

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

NodalHVDCTransportTechnology.docstring: A nodal representation of candidate HVDC transmission lines between two regions.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`)

power_systems_type.description: Corresponding type in PowerSystems.jl to be used in PCM modeling

capacity_limits.description: Allowable capacity for a transmission line (MW)

unit_size.description: Used for integer investment decisions. Represents the rating capacity of individual new lines (MW)

capital_costs.description: Cost of adding new capacity to the nodal transmission line. (USD/MW)

line_loss.description: Loss model coefficients. It accepts a linear model with a constant loss and a proportional loss rate. All terms are defined as fraction of installed nameplate capacity It also accepts a Piecewise loss, with N segments to specify different proportional losses for different segments.

financial_data.description: Struct containing relevant financial information for a technology

requirements.description: List of requirements (i.e. reserve margin, capacity requirements, energy share requirements) that are associated with a technology

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

AggregateTransportTechnology.docstring: An aggregated representation of a transmission interchange between two regions.

id.description: Numerical Index for AC transport technologies

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`)

power_systems_type.description: Corresponding type in PowerSystems.jl to be used in PCM modeling

capacity_limits.description: Allowable capacity for a transmission line (MW)

unit_size.description: Used for integer investment decisions. Represents the rating capacity of individual new lines (MW)

capital_costs.description: Cost of adding new capacity to the nodal transmission line. (USD/MW)

line_loss.description: Transmission loss for each transport technology (%)

financial_data.description: Struct containing relevant financial information for a technology

requirements.description: List of requirements (i.e. reserve margin, capacity requirements, energy share requirements) that are associated with a technology

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

NodalACTransportTechnology.docstring: Nodal representation of candidate AC transmission lines between two regions.

id.description: Numerical Index for AC transport technologies

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`)

power_systems_type.description: Corresponding type in PowerSystems.jl to be used in PCM modeling

capacity_limits.description: Allowable capacity for a transmission line (MW)

unit_size.description: Used for integer investment decisions. Represents the rating capacity of individual new lines (MW)

capital_costs.description: Cost of adding new capacity to the nodal transmission line (USD/MW).

financial_data.description: Struct containing relevant financial information for a technology

requirements.description: List of requirements (i.e. reserve margin, capacity requirements, energy share requirements) that are associated with a technology

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`)

power_systems_type.description: Corresponding type in PowerSystems.jl to be used in PCM modeling

new_demand_mw.description: The value of the peak demand to be used for new DemandRequirements.

new_construction_year.description: The year in which the new demand requirement will be installed. Should only be used for new demand requirements.

growth_rate.description: The annual growth rate of the demand requirement, used to scale present-day loads into future projections. Should only be used for conforming loads

conformity.description: Indicator of how the demand requirement should conform to the load profile of existing technologies in the system. Should only be used for new demand requirements.

unserved_demand_curve.description: Piecewise curve to scale the cost of unserved load based on the value of lost load

region.description: Zone or node where the demand requirement is located

requirements.description: List of requirements (i.e. reserve margin, capacity requirements, energy share requirements) that are associated with a technology

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

CarbonCaps.docstring: Defines limits to the amount of carbon produced. Can be defined either by the total amount of carbon produced (tons CO2) or by the carbon intensity of the portfolio (tons CO2 per MWh of electricity)

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`)

max_tons_mwh.description: Emission limit in terms of rate (tCO2/MWh)

target_year.description: Year in which carbon cap will be applied

max_mtons.description: Emission limit in absolute values (million tCO2)

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

CarbonTax.docstring: Policy requirement that defines an additional cost penalty per ton of CO2 produced in the target in the eligible regions

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`)

target_year.description: Year in which carbon tax will be applied

tax_dollars_per_ton.description: Cost penalty per ton of CO2 emitted by technologies in the eligible regions during the target year (USD/tCO2)

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

CapacityReserveMargin.docstring: Policy requirement to enforce a minimum capacity reserve margin, such that (total_capacity - peak_demand)/peak_demand >= capacity_reserve_fraction

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`)

target_year.description: Year in which capacity reserve margin will be applied

capacity_reserve_fraction.description: Capacity reserve requirements, represented as a fraction of peak demand in a region

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

MinimumCapacityRequirements.docstring: Policy requirement that the total capacity of all technologies in `eligible_technologies` in the target year is greater than or equal to the specific minimum in MW

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`)

min_capacity_mw.description: Minimum total capacity across all eligible resources (MW)

target_year.description: Year in which the capacity requirement will be applied

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

EnergyShareRequirements.docstring: Policy requirement that the total generation of `eligible_technologies` must be greater than or equal to a pre-determined fraction of the total demand in eligible zones, such that `sum(P)_eligible_technologies >= total_fraction * sum(D)_eligible_regions`

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`)

target_year.description: Year in which the energy share requirement will be applied

generation_fraction_requirement.description: Fraction of total annual demand across all eligible zones that needs to be met by eligible resources.

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

HourlyMatching.docstring: Policy requirement that all DemandSideTechnologies in `qualified_demand` must have their demand met by an equal amount of electricity generation from `qualified_supply` at all hours, such that: `sum(P)_qualified_supply >= sum(D)_qualified_demand`

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`)

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

MaximumCapacityRequirements.docstring: Policy requirement that the total capacity of all technologies in `eligible_resources` in the target year is less than the specified limit in MW

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`)

max_capacity_mw.description: Maximum total capacity across all eligible resources (MW)

target_year.description: Year in which the capacity requirement will be applied

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

Zone.docstring: A unit of spatial aggregation for zonal capacity expansion models. Used to define locations for supply, demand, transport, and storage technologies and relevant policy requirements.

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data

Node.docstring: A unit of spatial aggregation for nodal capacity expansion models. Used to define locations for supply, demand, transport, and storage technologies and relevant policy requirements.

bus_type.description: AC Bus Type for a node

ext.description: Optional dictionary to provide additional data
